name: Agent Starts Working
description: Flow when an agent begins working - blinds come down and state propagates to all windows

scenarios.description: Agent begins working, blinds animate down, state stored and broadcast to all windows

**Agent Started Working**

Session `{{session.id}}` in window {{window.id}} has started working. The blinds overlay is now visible and all windows have been notified.
